text:
maria: Quick flag — noticed landing CTR jumped 3.2x this morning and leads in the dashboard doubled vs yesterday. Can we do a quick huddle to reconcile numbers before the weekly KPI readout?
jon: On it. Which dashboard? the Launch > Webinar registration one?
sam: I pulled a quick CSV from GA and SFDC for the last 48h. GA shows traffic spike from /webinar/launch-page at 08:15 UTC. SFDC lead creation timestamps match surge around 08:20.
lee: My guess is an email test or creative rerun — ops sent a tiny blast to partners at 08:10. @ops-bot can you confirm?
ops-bot: Automated note: partner-blast-campaign-72 sent at 08:09 UTC to 4.2k recipients. Click-tracking enabled.
maria: Nice — that explains the raw lift. Two asks: 1) is attribution tagging correct (UTM params intact)? 2) are leads routing to the right SDR queues?
jon: UTM check: some links use utm_campaign=launch_v2 but others use launch_v2-b which our attribution rules map to the same campaign. There's a small mismatch on utm_content for partner A — might split into 'referral' bucket in our funnel.
sam: I attached a short extract (pasted below) of the SFDC lead records showing source fields:
```
lead_id,created_at,utm_campaign,utm_source,utm_content,assigned_queue
L-9981,2026-03-22T08:21:05Z,launch_v2,partner-a,organic-banner,SDR-EMEA
L-9982,2026-03-22T08:22:14Z,launch_v2-b,partner-a,partner-email,SDR-EMEA
L-9983,2026-03-22T08:24:33Z,launch_v2,organic,ad-1,SDR-NA
```
lee: Routing looks okay except those with launch_v2-b are hitting a fallback mapping and going to SDR-EMEA which is fine for now. But for attribution rollups we should unify utm_campaign values.
maria: Agreed. Can Marketing ops run a backfill to normalize utm_campaign for records from 08:05–09:00 and update the dashboard ETL tagging? If not backfillable, at least annotate the KPI readout.
jon: I can add a temporary tag in the dashboard: "partner-blast-08mar-08" and include a footnote on the weekly slide. Backfill will require a small data-job — I can open a ticket.
sam: Note: Please don't overwrite original campaign values in SFDC. Backfill should be an auxiliary field (campaign_normalized) so audit trail remains.
lee: I'll coordinate with Ops to standardize the partner links for future sends. Ops — can you version link templates?
ops-bot: Ops action queued: create link-template-v2 for partner emails. ETA 24h.
maria: Two more quick items for the KPI readout: - show daily vs baseline (7-day median) so this spike is obvious - include both GA-origin and SFDC-leads so we can show conversion rate delta
jon: I'll prep a slide with three small charts: traffic vs baseline, conversion %, and lead queue distribution. Will add footnote about utm mismatch and partner blast.
sam: Also recommend adding a mini-regression check: compare quality (MQL rate) of inbound from partner vs baseline for last 7 days. If conversion quality drops, call out potential noise.
maria: Perfect. Let's meet 09:45 for 15min to finalize slide before the KPI call at 10:30.
lee: Ack. Bringing the partner link change plan.
jon: Adding calendar invite now.
ops-bot: Calendar: 09:45–10:00 UTC booked for "KPI needle-check: webinar spike". Invite: maria, jon, sam, lee.
maria: Thanks all — will tuck this into the weekly KPIs and surface as "one-off partner blast" with normalized numbers.
jon: Quick note for posterity: consider adding an automated tag on dashboard when partner-blast is detected (based on UTM and campaign send events) so manual scrubs reduce. :thumbsup: 
lee: Good shout — ops, can you expose a webhook for these sends?
ops-bot: Webhook created: https://hooks.redwood.internal/partner-sends (auth required).
maria: Great — closing this thread. See you at 09:45. :wave:
